# wedos_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up an existing WEDOS DNS zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wedos_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.cz"
}

output "name_servers" {
  value = data.wedos_dns_zone.example.name_servers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name, e.g. example.cz.

### Read-Only

- `name_servers` (List of String) Authoritative name servers assigned by WEDOS.
- `record_count` (Number) Number of records in the zone as reported by WEDOS.
- `serial` (Number) SOA serial of the zone; 0 before the first commit.
- `status` (String) Zone status reported by WEDOS, e.g. active.
- `type` (String) Zone type: primary or secondary.
